newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's KP Holdings seen kicking off IPO soon-sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's KP Holdings seen kicking off IPO soon-sources.

text.p: Plastic component manufacturer KP Holdings Ltd is expected to hold a listing presentation for analysts on Friday, market sources said on Wednesday.
The company is expected to launch its initial public offering in Hong Kong later in December, sources said.
Lippo Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue but no further listing details were available, they said.
KP Holdings' core business is the manufacture of plastic key pads for electronic calculators.
